+    """Return finger-tip center and hand rotation in world coordinates."""
+    T = np.eye(4)
+    for i, (xyz, rpy) in enumerate(JOINT_ORIGINS):
+        A = np.eye(4)
+        A[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_euler("xyz", rpy).as_matrix()
+        A[:3, 3] = xyz
+        J = np.eye(4)

+    def residual(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+        p, R = panda_fk(q)
+        rot_error = Rotation.from_matrix(target_R @ R.T).as_rotvec()

+    camera_gl = np.stack([
+        (u - K[0, 2]) * depth / K[0, 0],
+        -(v - K[1, 2]) * depth / K[1, 1],
+        -depth,
+        np.ones_like(depth),
